title: Component Usage
description: How to use a component: when to use it, what not to use it for, when to use each variant option, and how it composes, including its named patterns (ADR-001 amendment 2026-11-10). The builder sections live in <Name>.spec.json (ADR-027). Writing rules for every prose field: name the reader's situation, not the component; give a checkable test (a count, a place, a condition), not an adjective; one idea per line; product nouns over abstractions, at most 3 examples in parentheses; prop names and values verbatim in backticks; no px, rem or CSS, no ADR numbers, no marketing words. Each fact once, in the field whose reader needs it. validate-usage lints the mechanical part.

description.description: One sentence, at most 25 words, opening "A <noun> that/for …" with one category noun, then what sets it apart. No sizes, counts, prop lists, ADR references or accessibility claims: those live in the spec. Lookalike contrasts go in notFor.

figmaNodeId.description: The Figma component set node id, or "none" when the component has no set (layout, text styles, single components).

useWhen.description: Situations where this component is the right choice at all, each at most 20 words, stated as the situation the reader is in. No instructions about props (spec constraints), no wrong picks (notFor), no per-option lines (variants.<axis>.useWhen).

notFor.description: Wrong picks: situations that look like this component but need another one. case = the situation; because = why it fails, so the rule generalises.

instead.description: A fixed-set component name, not prose (checked by validate-usage), or null when the alternative is outside the library; then say what in note.

variants.description: Named variant axes, one per visual prop in the spec (checked by validate-usage). Omit the section when the component has no visual prop; never declare a placeholder axis with one option.

default.description: Default option for this axis, or null when the axis is off by default (e.g. an icon-only shape applied only when set).

useWhen.description: Per option, at most 20 words: the situation first, then at most one clause on how it looks, to map a Figma instance. Sizes, CSS and required props belong in the spec.

composition.description: How this component composes: what it accepts, where it belongs, its parts, how it sizes, its named patterns, and the counts and don'ts for combining it.

accepts.description: Component names valid as direct children in this component's content slot. Empty array means leaf node. ["*"] means any library component is valid, and "*" is then the only entry. Names are checked against the exported components by scripts/validate-usage.js.

containedBy.description: Component names that are valid direct parents of this component. Checked against the exported components by scripts/validate-usage.js.

parts.description: Subcomponents reachable as <Name>.<Part> (ADR-023). Parts are not components: they have no folder and are declared only here. Cross-references (accepts/containedBy/builtOn) are checked by scripts/validate-usage.js.

name.description: PascalCase part name; also the Figma layer name (naming contract, ADR-023).

kind.description: fixed = content/state props only, layout owned by the parent's CSS Module; slot = exactly one child from accepts; open = any children from accepts, laid out by a primitive with fixed props.

builtOn.description: Library component this part renders (e.g. Stack for an open part), or null when it renders plain elements.

required.description: Whether every instance of each containedBy part must include this part as a direct child.

accepts.description: Component or sibling-part names valid as direct children. slot and open parts only.

containedBy.description: Sibling-part names valid as this part's direct parent. Omit when the part may appear anywhere (e.g. Root).

width.description: fill = stretches to parent width; hug = sizes to content; fixed = component sets its own width.

nests.description: Whether an instance can sit inside another instance of the same component. Checked by validate-layout.

limits.description: Counts as data, checked by validate-layout. per: region = the nearest <section>; repeated = inside a repeated item (CardVertical, CardHorizontal or a .map()); parent = the direct parent.

if.description: Variant axis → option the limit applies to.

patterns.description: Named, approved compositions this component owns (ADR-001 amendment 2026-11-10). Each name is the PascalCase export of a story in <Name>.patterns.stories.tsx, which holds the code; usage.json holds only the name and when to use it.

name.description: kebab-case id shared with the story export (PascalCase), the Figma example frame and spec.anatomyExamples[].pattern.

useWhen.description: The situation a layout is in when this pattern fits, at most 20 words, not a description of the tree.

donts.description: Composition don'ts that can't be stated as data: placement, grouping, weight in context. Same shape as notFor, but instead is prose. because says why, so the rule generalises.

instead.description: What to do instead, in prose.
